---
id: morph-with-crossfader
title: Morph between scenes with the crossfader
modes: [live-looper, groovebox]
concepts: [scene, crossfader]
sources: [scene, crossfader]
---

Assign scene A and scene B, then sweep the crossfader to interpolate parameters.

## Steps

1. Lock parameters into scene A.
2. Lock different values into scene B.
3. Move the crossfader to morph.

## Variations & subtleties

- Snap vs smooth morph depends on parameter type.
